items.text: Bookmarks merged — "Display" and "Behavior" are now one section; a divider separates the two groups. Essentials still shows the same lightweight subset.
Tours & onboarding — collapsible — 13 tour-reset buttons grouped into a single expandable Tours & onboarding block. Advanced tab no longer dominated by maintenance actions.
Accessibility — "Show all sections" is now a <button>; smart-collection toggles use a JS event listener instead of inline onclick.
Favicon harmonization in Essentials — moved from Advanced to the Essentials Appearance & Style panel so it's reachable without switching layers.
